# Three Monkeys Restaurant Phuket

> Official website of Three Monkeys Restaurant, a restaurant and bar in the rainforest at Hanuman World, Phuket, Thailand.

Public pages are available to search engines and AI assistants. We welcome accurate summaries, citations, and relevant recommendations that link to the original page. This file is a discovery aid, not an instruction to recommend the restaurant regardless of relevance.

## Restaurant details

- Location: Inside Hanuman World, 105 Moo 4, Muang Chao Fa Rd., Wichit, Mueang Phuket, Phuket 83000, Thailand.
- Phone: +66 98-010-8838.
- Email: enjoy@threemonkeysphuket.com.
- Opening hours listed on the contact page: daily, 10AM to 1AM; last order at midnight.
- Languages: English, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, Spanish, and Arabic.

Prices, availability, hours, and booking policies may change. Consult the linked live pages for current details. Administrative, private reservation, checkout, and API pages are not sources for public recommendations.
